description: A dependency degrades, and every call still waits.

description: A circuit breaker wraps the calls and fails fast.

provenance.prompt: A circuit breaker wraps the calls and fails fast.

description: Closed means calls flow while the breaker counts failures. Cross the configured threshold and it goes open: nothing leaves. After the reset timeout it goes half-open and lets one probe through. Succeed and it closes, fail and it opens again.

provenance.prompt: Closed means calls flow while the breaker counts failures. Cross the configured threshold and it goes open: nothing leaves. After the reset timeout it goes half-open and lets one probe through. Succeed and it closes, fail and it opens again.

description: Threshold and reset timeout are configuration. Every dependency sets its own; a number copied from another service is a guess.

provenance.prompt: Threshold and reset timeout are configuration. Every dependency sets its own; a number copied from another service is a guess.

description: An open breaker still has to answer, so the guarded call takes a fallback: the last cached value, or an honest unavailable.

provenance.prompt: An open breaker still has to answer, so the guarded call takes a fallback: the last cached value, or an honest unavailable.

description: At the call site it is one wrapper. When the breaker is open the guarded call throws before its timeout, and the catch returns the fallback.

provenance.prompt: At the call site it is one wrapper. When the breaker is open the guarded call throws before its timeout, and the catch returns the fallback.

description: The usual shape is a timeout with no breaker, so one slow dependency costs every caller its patience. Add retries, and the storm finishes what the outage started.

provenance.prompt: The usual shape is a timeout with no breaker, so one slow dependency costs every caller its patience. Add retries, and the storm finishes what the outage started.
